site_title: dragoman: humusha noma yiliphi ikhasi, khona lapho likhona
site_step_draft_detail: I-Bergamot, injini evulekile yokuhumusha esekela i-Firefox Translations, isebenza ngaphakathi esipheqululini sakho. Ikhasi liyafundeka cishe ngomzuzwana, futhi umbhalo awulokothi uphume ekhompyutheni yakho.
site_step_refine_detail: Izigaba ezisesikrinini ziya kumodeli yakho ye-AI nesihloko sekhasi, ukuze amagama, iphimbo namatemu kuhlale kufana. Izixhumanisi, umbhalo ogqamile nokufometha kubuyela khona kanye lapho bekukhona.
site_step_hover_detail: Beka isikhombi phezu kwanoma yisiphi isigaba ukuze ufunde obekushiwo ngaphambili. Ukuchofoza kanye ebhejini, noma u-Alt+Shift+T, kubuyisela lonke ikhasi.
site_models_detail: Namathisela ukhiye ovela kunoma yimuphi walaba bahlinzeki, noma usebenzise imodeli kukhompyutha yakho. Okhiye bahlala esipheqululini sakho, futhi izicelo ziya ngqo kumhlinzeki. Ayikho iseva ye-dragoman phakathi.
site_cast_detail: Emakhulwini eminyaka, ama-dragoman ayedlulisa incazelo phakathi kwesigodlo sama-Ottoman nomhlaba wonke. Khetha oyedwa ozohamba nawe kuwo wonke amakhasi owahumushayo.
site_languages_detail: Yonke indawo yokusebenzisa itholakala ngezilimi ezingu-{count}, kusukela ku-Afrikaans kuya ku-isiZulu, futhi imodeli yakho ye-AI ingahumushela amakhasi kunoma yiluphi ulimi elwaziyo.
site_privacy_detail: Ayikho i-akhawunti, ayikho iseva, akukho ukuhlaziywa. Izilungiselelo zihlala esipheqululini sakho. Umbhalo uya kuphela kumodeli oyikhethile, futhi amamodeli olimi asedivayisini alandwa kanye kuphela ku-Mozilla.
docs_intro: Konke okudingayo ukuze ufake i-dragoman, uxhume imodeli futhi uyigcine isebenza.
docs_install_2: Vula i-helium://extensions, noma i-chrome://extensions kwezinye iziphequluli, bese uvula imodi yonjiniyela.
docs_install_3: Khetha okuthi Layisha okungapakishiwe bese ukhetha ifolda ekhishiwe.
docs_install_4: Phina i-dragoman kubha yamathuluzi ukuze ifinyeleleke ngokuchofoza kanye.
docs_first_detail: Vula noma iyiphi iwebhusayithi, chofoza isithonjana se-dragoman, khetha ulimi bese ukhetha okuthi Humusha ikhasi. U-Alt+Shift+T, noma u-Option+Shift+T ku-Mac, wenza okufanayo kusuka kukhibhodi. Okusalungiswa kuvela kudwetshelwe ngamachashazi egolide, anyamalala njengoba imodeli yakho ithuthukisa isigaba ngasinye.
docs_model_detail: Vula Izilungiselelo kusuka ewindini elivelayo, khetha umhlinzeki bese ulandela izinyathelo ezintathu. I-dragoman ihlola ukhiye ngokushesha nje uma uwunamathisela futhi ikhethe kusengaphambili imodeli esheshayo nengabizi, ongayishintsha noma nini.
docs_model_openrouter: I-OpenRouter ingakudalela ukhiye. Khetha okuthi Xhuma nge-OpenRouter bese uvuma isicelo.
docs_model_anthropic: Okhiye be-Anthropic abangaxhunyiwe endaweni yokusebenzela badinga ne-ID yendawo yokusebenzela. Uzoyithola ku-Anthropic Console ngaphansi kwe-Settings, bese u-Workspaces.
docs_local_ollama: Faka i-Ollama, landa imodeli efana ne-gemma3, bese uyiqala i-OLLAMA_ORIGINS isethiwe ukuze yamukele izicelo ezivela kusandiso:
docs_local_lmstudio: Ku-LM Studio, layisha imodeli, vula i-CORS kuzilungiselelo zeseva bese uqala iseva yasendaweni. I-dragoman iyithola ku-localhost:1234.
docs_cost_detail: I-dragoman imahhala. Ukuthuthukisa kusebenza ngokhiye wakho, ngakho umhlinzeki ukukhokhisa ngqo. Amamodeli amancane nasheshayo avamise ukwanela ukuhumusha. Ithebhu ethi Ukusetshenziswa kuzilungiselelo ibala ama-token emodelini ngayinye njalo ngenyanga, futhi uma uvula ethi Bonisa izindleko zekhasi ngalinye, izindleko zekhasi elikhona zivela eduze kwebheji.
docs_privacy_sent: Okushiya ikhompyutha yakho: izigaba ezisesikrinini nalezo ezilandelayo, kanye nanoma yimuphi umbhalo ocela umngane wakho ukuthi awuhumushe, kuthunyelwa kumhlinzeki owukhethile, kanye nokulandwa kwesikhathi esisodwa kwamamodeli olimi asedivayisini avela ku-Mozilla. Ukhiye wakho uthunyelwa kuphela kumhlinzeki wawo. I-dragoman ayinayo iseva, i-akhawunti noma i-analytics.
docs_help_blocked: Iwindi elivelayo lithi ikhasi alikwazi ukuhunyushwa
docs_help_blocked_detail: Amakhasi esiphequluli afana nezilungiselelo, ikhasi lezandiso nezitolo zewebhu awavumeli izandiso ukuthi ziwashintshe. Vula iwebhusayithi evamile esikhundleni salokho.
docs_help_engine: Injini esedivayisini ayinayo imodeli yalezi zilimi
docs_help_engine_detail: I-Bergamot ihlanganisa izilimi ezisetshenziswa kakhulu. Kwezinye, engeza imodeli ye-AI futhi i-dragoman izohumusha ngayo ngqo.
docs_help_local_detail: Qinisekisa ukuthi iseva iyasebenza nokuthi ikheli layo ku-Izilungiselelo liyafana. I-Ollama idinga i-OLLAMA_ORIGINS, kanti i-LM Studio idinga ukuthi i-CORS ivulwe.
privacy_intro: I-dragoman ayinayo iseva, i-akhawunti noma ukuhlaziywa kwedatha. Leli khasi libala konke isandiso nale webhusayithi okwenzayo ngedatha yakho.
privacy_device_local: Izilungiselelo zakho, okhiye be-API, izibalo zamathokheni zanyanga zonke nendawo lapho umngane wakho ehlala khona kugcinwa kusitoreji sezandiso sesiphequluli sakho. Ukuhumusha okusedivayisini kwenziwa ngaphakathi kwesiphequluli sakho yinjini ye-Bergamot, ngakho umbhalo awulokothi uphume ekhompyutheni yakho.
privacy_saved: I-dragoman iphinde igcine ukuhumusha ekwenzayo esiphequluli sakho, kufakwe ngaphansi kwesigxivizo sombhalo wokuqala, ukuze amakhasi obuyela kuwo avele ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuphinda ibuze imodeli ye-AI. Uma umbhalo ushintsha, nesigxivizo sawo siyashintsha bese uhunyushwa kabusha. Ukuhumusha okugciniwe okungasetshenziswanga izinsuku ezingu-90 kuyasuswa, amawindi angasese awagcini lutho, futhi ungakusula konke ngaphansi kokuthi Ukusetshenziswa kuzilungiselelo zesandiso.
privacy_detect: Ukuze ibone ulimi lwekhasi futhi isebenzise imithetho yakho yokuhumusha okuzenzakalelayo, i-dragoman ifunda isampula elifushane lezihloko nezigaba zekhasi ngalinye uma lilayisha, ilidlulisele kusitholi solimi esakhelwe esipheqululini sakho. Lokhu nakho kwenzeka kudivayisi yakho.
privacy_model_text: Uma wengeza imodeli ye-AI, i-dragoman iyithumelela izigaba ezisesikrinini nezimbalwa ngaphambi kwalapho uskrola khona, kanye nesihloko sekhasi nezilimi zombili. Okuningi kuthunyelwa kuphela njengoba uskrola, noma konke kanyekanye uma uvula okuthi Humusha lonke ikhasi kanyekanye. Uma ucela ukuthi isigaba sihunyushwe futhi, ukuhumusha kwaso kwamanje kuyahamba naso ukuze imodeli yenze kangcono; uma ukhetha umbhalo bese ukhetha okuthi Humusha okukhethiwe, kuthunyelwa kuphela izigaba ezithintwayo; futhi uma ucela umngane wakho ukuthi ahumushe umbhalo owukhethile, nawo uyathunyelwa. Izicelo ziya ngqo zisuka esiphequluli sakho ziye kumhlinzeki omkhethile, ngokhiye wakho, futhi kusebenza inqubomgomo yobumfihlo yalowo mhlinzeki. I-Ollama ne-LM Studio zisebenza kukhompyutha yakho, ngakho akukho okuphumayo kuyo.
privacy_models: Okokuqala uma uhumusha ipheya lezilimi kudivayisi, i-dragoman ilanda imodeli yalo kusitoreji samamodeli se-Mozilla bese iyigcina esipheqululini sakho. Lezi zicelo zisho ipheya lezilimi kuphela.
privacy_openrouter: Okuthi Xhuma nge-OpenRouter kuvula ikhasi lokungena le-OpenRouter uqobo. Ukhiye olibuyisayo ugcinwa njenganoma yimuphi omunye ukhiye.
privacy_never: Ayinayo iseva yayo, ayiqoqi ukuhlaziywa noma imibiko yokuphahlazeka, ayikhombisi izikhangiso, futhi ayilokothi idayise noma yabelane ngedatha yakho. Ukhiye ngamunye uthunyelwa kuphela kumhlinzeki wawo.
privacy_permission_sites: Funda futhi ushintshe idatha yakho kuwo wonke amawebhusayithi
privacy_permission_sites_detail: Ihumusha amakhasi khona lapho, futhi ifinyelela kumhlinzeki we-AI noma iseva yasendaweni oyisethile.
privacy_permission_storage_detail: Igcina izilungiselelo zakho, okhiye, ukusetshenziswa nokuhumusha okugciniwe kule divayisi.
privacy_site: I-dragoman.io iyisayithi emile ehlinzekwa yi-Cloudflare. Ayibeki ama-cookie, ayisebenzisi izinhlelo zokuhlaziya futhi ayilayishi lutho kwamanye amasevisi, ngaphandle kwefilimu yokwethulwa, edlala ku-YouTube kumodi yobumfihlo obuthuthukisiwe kuphela uma ukhetha ukuyibuka. I-Cloudflare ingagcina amarekhodi ajwayelekile ezicelo ukuze iqhube inethiwekhi yayo.
privacy_changes: Uma le nqubomgomo ishintsha, inguqulo entsha izovela kuleli khasi inosuku olusha.
character_envoy_detail: Uthwala izincwadi phakathi kwezigodlo futhi akhulumele izinhlangothi zombili zetafula.
character_scholar_detail: Sifunda imibhalo eyisikhombisa kodwa sisahlola isichazamazwi.
offer_setting_detail: Uma ikhasi lisolimini ongalufundi, i-dragoman ivela ekhoneni bese ibuza kuqala.

known_empty: Akukabi khona. I-dragoman izonikeza ukuhumusha wonke ikhasi elingekho olimini lwakho oluhlosiwe.
show_cost_detail: Ibonisa izindleko ze-AI zekhasi elikhona eduze kwebheji nasefasiteleni lethuluzi. Amanani avela kumhlinzeki uma ewabika, uma kungenjalo avela ohlwini lwamanani lomphakathi lwe-OpenRouter.
page_cost_unknown: Leli khasi: ama-token angu-{tokens}, inani alaziwa
privacy_prices: Uma uvula ethi Bonisa izindleko zekhasi ngalinye, i-dragoman ilanda uhlu lomphakathi lwe-OpenRouter lwamanani amamodeli kanye ngosuku kuphela. Isicelo asinawo umbhalo wekhasi, ukhiye noma olunye ulwazi ngawe.
site_meta: Isandiso sokuhumusha amakhasi se-Chrome, i-Firefox ne-Safari. Idivayisi yakho isalungisa isigaba ngasinye ngomzuzwana, bese imodeli ye-AI oyikhethayo iyithuthukisa icabangela lonke ikhasi.
site_lead: I-dragoman ihumusha amawebhusayithi khona lapho ekhona, ku-Chrome, i-Firefox ne-Safari, kukhompyutha nakufoni yakho. Idivayisi yakho isalungisa isigaba ngasinye ngomzuzwana, bese imodeli ye-AI oyikhethayo iyithuthukisa icabangela lonke ikhasi.
site_note: Kumahhala futhi kungumthombo ovulekile. Izixhumanisi, izithombe nokuhlelwa kuhlala ncamashi lapho bekukhona.

story_detail: Landela ikhasi elilodwa kusukela ekuchofozeni kokuqala kuya ekuthuthukisweni kokugcina.
step_open_detail: Izindaba, izindlela zokupheka, izitolo noma imibhalo, nganoma yiluphi ulimi. Chofoza i-dragoman, uyithinte efonini yakho, noma ucindezele u-Alt+Shift+T.
devices_detail: I-dragoman efanayo isebenza ku-Chrome nakwezinye iziphequluli ze-Chromium, ku-Firefox kumakhompyutha nasezingcingweni ze-Android, naku-Safari ku-Mac, iPhone ne-iPad.
chrome_android_note: I-Chrome ye-Android ayizisebenzisi izandiso. Ku-Android, sebenzisa i-Firefox.
site_footer_license: Kumahhala futhi kungumthombo ovulekile, ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-MIT.
docs_install_chromium: I-Chrome, i-Edge, i-Brave, i-Arc nezinye iziphequluli ze-Chromium
docs_first_mobile: Efonini noma kuthebhulethi, vula i-dragoman kumenyu yezandiso yesiphequluli sakho.
docs_help_access_detail: I-Safari ne-Firefox zikuvumela ukhethe ukuthi yimaphi amawebhusayithi isandiso esingawafunda. Vula i-dragoman bese ukhetha okuthi Vumela kuwo wonke amawebhusayithi.
docs_help_consent_detail: I-Firefox iyabuza ngaphambi kokuthi isandiso sithumele umbhalo wekhasi noma kuphi. Vula Izilungiselelo bese ukhetha okuthi Vumela ukuthumela umbhalo wekhasi ngaphansi kwemodeli yakho.
privacy_permission_engine_detail: Isebenzisa injini yokuhumusha esedivayisini ngemuva. Iziphequluli ze-Chromium kuphela.
privacy_permission_signin_detail: Kusetshenziswa kuphela okuthi Xhuma nge-OpenRouter, ezipheqululini ezinewindi lokungena.
privacy_firefox_consent: I-Firefox icela imvume yakho ngaphambi kokuthi i-dragoman ithumele umbhalo wekhasi kumhlinzeki we-AI, futhi ungayihoxisa noma nini kuzilungiselelo zezengezo ze-Firefox.
privacy_openrouter_return: Ezipheqululini ezingenalo iwindi lokungena, i-OpenRouter ikubuyisela ku-dragoman.io isikhashana. Isandiso sithatha ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa ekhelini bese sivala ithebhu. Leyo khodi ayilutho ngaphandle kwemfihlo engalokothi iphume esipheqululini sakho.
reload_needed: Layisha kabusha leli khasi ukuze i-dragoman ikwazi ukulihumusha.
welcome_access_safari: Uma i-Safari ibuza, khetha ethi Always Allow on Every Website ukuze i-dragoman ikwazi ukuhumusha amakhasi owavulayo.
privacy_permission_native_detail: Ibuza ukubona ulimi kuka-Apple okusedivayisini ukuthi ikhasi lingaluphi ulimi. Ku-Safari kuphela, futhi umbhalo awulokothi uphume kudivayisi yakho.
maker_meta: UFırat Çiftçi wenza i-dragoman, kusukela kusandiso nabalingiswa bayo kuya efilimini nakule webhusayithi.
maker_name_note: Okusalungiswa kuhumushe igama lami igama ngegama: iFırat yisiTurkey somfula i-Euphrates, kanti uÇiftçi usho umlimi. Imodeli yakho ifunde lonke ikhasi yase ilibuyisa.
maker_intro: Ngakhe izichazamazwi zesiTurkey, izingobo zomlando e-University of Chicago, nebalazwe lazo zonke izinja ezinelayisensi eNew York. Ngenza i-dragoman, kusukela kusandiso nabalingiswa bayo kuya efilimini nakule webhusayithi. Ngihlala eBrooklyn.
maker_river_intro: Isizwe ngasinye ngasemfuleni i-Euphrates safunda igama lawo kwabandulelayo sase silidlulisa ngolimi lwaso, njengoba kwenza ama-dragoman. Lifunde ulandela umfula, amagama aya ngokuba madala, kuze kufike kumaSumer.
maker_river_signs: Ababhali besi-Akkad nabesiSumer babebhala umfula ngezimpawu ezifanayo, kodwa bezifunda ngezindlela ezimbili ezihlukene.
maker_work_everydog: Ibalazwe lazo zonke izinja ezingu-96,459 ezinelayisensi eNew York City, ezindaweni zayo ezingu-197.
maker_work_sozluk: Isichazamazwi semvelaphi yamagama esiTurkey. Ngakha futhi ngiphethe iwebhusayithi yaso, izinhlelo zaso ze-iPhone ne-Android, nephaneli abahleli abasebenza kuyo.
maker_work_yeradlari: Amagama akudala nanamuhla ezindawo ezingu-70,000 eTurkey nasemazweni angomakhelwane, anamagama amadala angu-77,000 ngezilimi ezingu-34.
maker_work_ottoman: Imibhalo esezakhiweni ze-Ottoman ezingaphezu kuka-1,100 eTurkey, eGreece naseGibhithe, kanye nokuguqulelwa kwayo ngezinhlamvu nezithombe.
maker_shahmaran: Isithombe eseduze kwesithombe sami yiShahmaran, ingxenye yowesifazane nengxenye yenyoka, evela ezinganekwaneni zase-Anatolia, eMesopotamia nase-Iran. Lesi sidwetshwe ngumngane wami u-{friend}.
meaning_lead: Ama-dragoman ayengabahumushi, abatoliki nabaqondisi ababethwala amazwi phakathi kwenkantolo yase-Ottoman kanye nezinxusa, amahhovisi amanxusa nezindawo zokuhweba zaseYurophu. Kwakufanele bazi isiTurkey, isi-Arabhu nesiPheshiya, kanye nezilimi zaseYurophu.
meaning_quote_by: Inxusa laseVenice ngeminyaka yawo-1700, likhuluma ngama-dragoman alo
meaning_word: Igama ngokwalo ladlula kusuka olimini kuya kolunye.
meaning_fact_porte: U-Dragoman wokuqala we-Sublime Porte, uPanagiotis Nikousios, wayengumGreki, futhi iningi lezikhulu ezabusa iWallachia neMoldavia kusukela ngo-1711 kuya ku-1821 lalike laba nalesi sikhundla.
meaning_fact_tax: Ama-dragoman ayengakhokhi intela, futhi ama-dragoman amanxusa ayevame ukuhlangana nezikhulu zase-Ottoman inxusa lawo lingekho.
meaning_fact_office: Ngesikhathi se-Tanzimat, iHhovisi Lokuhumusha le-Sublime Porte laba ngenye yezindlela eziqinisekile zokuthola amandla kuhulumeni wase-Ottoman.
model_overview: I-dragoman ihumusha kudivayisi yakho kusukela ekuqaleni. Engeza imodeli ye-AI ukuze uthole ukuhumusha okuzwakala kahle okusebenzisa lonke ikhasi njengomongo. Ukhiye wakho uhlala kulesi siphequluli, futhi izicelo ziya ngqo kumhlinzeki.
provider_none_info: Ihumusha kudivayisi yakho, ngokushesha nangasese. Ayikho i-akhawunti edingekayo.
draft_locally_info: Ibonisa ngokushesha ukuhumusha okusheshayo kule divayisi, bese ikufaka esikhundleni sokwemodeli yakho ye-AI. Vala ukuze ulinde imodeli yodwa.
models_detail: Engeza eyodwa noma ngaphezulu. Uma zininzi, shintsha phakathi kwazo ku-popup yebha yamathuluzi noma ekhasini.
welcome_ai: Ukuhumusha sekuvele kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, kudivayisi yakho. Ukuze uthole ukuhumusha okuzwakala kahle, engeza imodeli ye-AI ngezansi.
usage_none: Akukho okwamanje. Amakhasi ahunyushwe yimodeli ye-AI azovela lapha.
saved_translations_detail: Ukuhumusha kuhlala kule divayisi, ukuze amakhasi obuyela kuwo avele ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuphinda ubuze imodeli ye-AI. Umbhalo oshintshayo uhunyushwa kabusha, noma yini engasetshenziswanga izinsuku ezingu-90 iyasuswa, futhi amawindi angasese awagcini lutho.
data_consent_send: I-Firefox iyabuza ngaphambi kokuthi isandiso sithumele umbhalo wekhasi noma kuphi. Kuvumele ukuze i-dragoman ithumele izigaba ku-{provider} ukuze zihunyushwe.
translated_device: Izigaba ezingu-{done} kwezingu-{total} zihunyushwe kule divayisi
whole_page_detail: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo ukonga isikhathi nezindleko ze-AI: i-dragoman ihumusha lokho okubonayo, bese iqhubeka njengoba uskrola.
companion: Gcina i-dragoman yakho kuwo wonke amakhasi
companion_detail: Bahlala onqenqemeni lwewindi. Badonsele noma kuphi, ubathinte kancane, noma ukhethe umbhalo bazokunikeza ukuwuhumusha.
pet_morning: Sawubona ekuseni! Ikhofi kuqala, bese kuba izilimi.
pet_afternoon: Sawubona ntambama! Akhona amakhasi adinga utolika?
pet_evening: Sawubona kusihlwa. Izibani zikhanyisiwe nezichazamazwi zivuliwe.
pet_night: Usaphapheme? Ngisho notolika basesigodlweni babelala kwesinye isikhathi.
pet_done: Kuphelile! Beka isikhombi kunoma yisiphi isigaba ukuze ubone okokuqala.
pet_done_touch: Kuphelile! Thepha noma yisiphi isigaba ukuze ubone okokuqala.
pet_dizzy: Hhawu… ngibona nibabili. Izilimi ezimbili ngempela.
pet_fact_name: Isiqu sami sivela egameni lesi-Akkadian elithi targumannu, “utolika”. Sahamba ngesi-Aramaic, isi-Arabhu nesiTurkey ukufika kuwe.
pet_fact_porte: Ama-dragoman ase-Sublime Porte ayehumusha izivumelwano, izincwadi kanye nenhlamba yasebukhosini ngezikhathi ezithile. Ngenhlonipho enkulu.
pet_fact_count: Kukhulunywa izilimi ezingaba ngu-7,000 namuhla. Ngisazisebenzela.
pet_fact_coffee: Isisho saseTurkey: inkomishi yekhofi ikhunjulwa iminyaka engamashumi amane.
pet_fact_two: Isisho sakudala: ulimi olulodwa, umuntu oyedwa; izilimi ezimbili, abantu ababili.
pet_fact_rosetta: I-Rosetta Stone isho into efanayo kathathu. Otolika bakubiza ngokuthi isiqalo esihle.
pet_fact_look: Kuthiwa isi-Yaghan sinegama elithi mamihlapinatapai: ukubukana kwabantu ababili abathemba ukuthi omunye uzoqala.
pet_fact_carry: Amanye amagama awahambi. Ngakho-ke ngithwala incazelo esikhundleni sawo.
docs_install_stores: Faka i-dragoman esitolo sesiphequluli sakho, futhi izozibuyekeza ngokwayo isuka lapho.
docs_install_github: Konke ukukhishwa kutholakala naku-GitHub, kunama-zip ezifunda ze-Chromium ne-Firefox kanye nekhodi yomthombo ephelele. Ukufaka i-zip ye-Chromium ngesandla:
docs_install_unzip: Landa i-zip ye-Chrome ekukhishweni kwakamuva bese uyivula.
lost_lead: Ama-dragoman ethu aphenye yonke imiqulu ehhovisi lombuso kodwa akatholanga lutho kuleli kheli. Kungenzeka ukuthi ikhasi lithuthiwe, noma alizange libhalwe nhlobo.
lost_quip: Umbhali ufunga ukuthi walifaka efayilini. Umbhali usedluliselwe komunye umsebenzi.
error_lead: Leli khasi liwohlokile lisendleleni eza kuwe. Lilayishe kabusha, noma uqale phansi ekhasini lasekhaya.
